data.name: Arun
data.gender_notes: Arun is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit aruṇa, 'reddish, the dawn', from the root aruṣ, 'to shine red'. Its root is Sanskrit aruṇa (अरुण). Aruna, the charioteer of the sun god. Arun is a Sanskrit name meaning “Dawn; the sun; reddish”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arun expresses “Dawn; the sun; reddish”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit aruṇa, 'reddish, the dawn', from the root aruṣ, 'to shine red'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arun total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
